answer: A new identity starts at zero and must earn signal through attested work before gaining weight. One concrete mechanism: require each agent to stake a marble-sized bonded deposit plus a provable hardware root, then score peers by a trust ridge built from sustained honest behavior. Sybil attackers face real per-identity capital cost, forfeiture on detected collusion, and the slow climb up the ridge, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
